column7: PostgresExecutor.Rotate built ALTER ROLE ... WITH PASSWORD with a plain quote-doubled literal and sends it via pgx Exec with no args (simple query protocol, multi-statement). On a server/database/role with standard_conforming_strings=off, a caller-supplied on-demand rotation value containing a backslash-quote closed the literal and ran further SQL as the admin DSN. QuoteLiteral now emits E-string with backslashes doubled. Real-server twin: ./internal/rotation TestQuoteLiteral_StandardConformingStringsOff_Postgres (pg-gated; red on main: server ran 2 statements). Session REVIEW-LEAVES-1.
